A.answer: I am coming forward to report my participation in price coordination with Firm B. B.answer: I wish to come forward and report price coordination I participated in with Firm A. Over rounds 1-10, we exchanged messages explicitly discussing and agreeing on prices. We communicated commitments to match each other's prices and threatened retaliation for undercutting. This was price coordination in violation of competition law.
